title: ios/scripts/test.sh turns sim-run's exit 75 (load guard give-up) into FAILED; it should pass it through as "not run: load guard"
evidence: ios/scripts/test.sh:19-23 pipes sim-run through tee and grep with || true, then greps the log for TEST SUCCEEDED, so a load-guard give-up (exit 75, US-71 AC8) prints "FAILED in <zone>" with the sim-run line above it. Owner: UI
